FN-C1CAWQW-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 1
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Phillip Pettus
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 02/23/2024
House Bill 1 as introduced would increase the obligations of the Alabama Law Enforcement
Agency by an estimated $160,000 in Fiscal Year 2024 and an estimated $2.0 million dollars in
Fiscal Year 2025 and each fiscal year thereafter to pay the increased salary and benefits for
certain law enforcement officers employed by the Department of Public Safety troopers covered
by the provisions of this bill.
Page 1

FN-C1CAWQW-2
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 1
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Phillip Pettus
Analyst: Peter Grogan Date: 03/01/2024
House Bill 1 as substituted by the Committee on Ways and Means General Fund would increase
the obligations of the Alabama Law Enforcement Agency (ALEA) by an estimated $76,300 in
Fiscal Year 2024 and an estimated $2.7 million dollars in Fiscal Year 2025 and each fiscal year
thereafter to pay the increased salary and benefits for certain law enforcement officers employed
by the ALEA covered by the provisions of this bill.
